title: AI Demand Grows, but the Chip Industry Moves at Different Speeds

sources.name: ASML
sources.title: ASML reports €11.7 billion total net sales and €5.0 billion net income in Q3 2026

paragraphs.en: Intel's October 29, 2026 earnings release
paragraphs.zh: 英特爾於2026年10月29日發布的財報

paragraphs.en: shows why the chip industry deserves a closer look.
paragraphs.zh: 顯示出為何值得更仔細觀察晶片產業。

paragraphs.en: The company reported third-quarter revenue of $16.5 billion,
paragraphs.zh: 該公司公布第三季營收為165億美元，

paragraphs.en: an increase of 21% from a year earlier.
paragraphs.zh: 比前一年同期增加21%。

paragraphs.en: However, the headline does not describe every business
paragraphs.zh: 不過，這項整體數字並不能充分說明每項業務

paragraphs.en: within the company equally well.
paragraphs.zh: 在公司內部各自的表現。

paragraphs.en: Its detailed figures reveal a sharp contrast
paragraphs.zh: 細項數據揭露了鮮明的對比：

paragraphs.en: between rapidly expanding data-center activity
paragraphs.zh: 資料中心相關業務快速擴張，

paragraphs.en: and weaker results in another major group.
paragraphs.zh: 另一個主要事業群的表現卻較疲弱。

paragraphs.en: Intel's Data Center and AI group
paragraphs.zh: 英特爾的資料中心暨人工智慧事業群

paragraphs.en: recorded revenue of $7.3 billion,
paragraphs.zh: 錄得73億美元營收，

paragraphs.en: up 78% from the same quarter last year.
paragraphs.zh: 比去年同季增加78%。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, its Client Computing and Physical AI group
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，其用戶端運算暨實體人工智慧事業群

paragraphs.en: reported $8.1 billion, down 5%.
paragraphs.zh: 公布營收為81億美元，下降5%。

paragraphs.en: The second group remained larger by revenue,
paragraphs.zh: 第二個事業群的營收規模仍較大，

paragraphs.en: even though its growth rate was lower.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管它的成長率較低。

paragraphs.en: This comparison shows why business size
paragraphs.zh: 這項比較說明了，業務規模

paragraphs.en: and speed of growth should be considered separately.
paragraphs.zh: 與成長速度應分開看待。

paragraphs.en: ASML's October 14 results offer another perspective.
paragraphs.zh: 艾司摩爾於10月14日公布的業績提供了另一種觀察角度。

paragraphs.en: The chipmaking equipment supplier reported
paragraphs.zh: 這家晶片製造設備供應商公布，

paragraphs.en: quarterly sales of approximately €11.7 billion.
paragraphs.zh: 季度銷售額約為117億歐元。

paragraphs.en: It sold 113 new lithography systems,
paragraphs.zh: 它售出113套新的微影系統，

paragraphs.en: compared with 86 in the previous quarter.
paragraphs.zh: 相較之下，前一季為86套。

paragraphs.en: That is a measure of equipment sales,
paragraphs.zh: 這是衡量設備銷售的指標，

paragraphs.en: rather than the number of finished computer chips.
paragraphs.zh: 並非製成的電腦晶片數量。

paragraphs.en: The distinction helps place ASML's announcement
paragraphs.zh: 這項區別有助於將艾司摩爾的公告

paragraphs.en: within the wider manufacturing supply chain.
paragraphs.zh: 放回更廣泛的製造供應鏈脈絡中理解。

paragraphs.en: ASML also described increasing customer demand forecasts
paragraphs.zh: 艾司摩爾也描述了客戶需求預測上升的情況，

paragraphs.en: linked primarily to expectations about AI investment.
paragraphs.zh: 主要與對人工智慧投資的預期有關。

paragraphs.en: Management said its currently planned supply
paragraphs.zh: 管理階層表示，目前規劃的供應量

paragraphs.en: would not fully satisfy customer demand
paragraphs.zh: 預計無法完全滿足客戶需求，

paragraphs.en: in either 2027 or 2028.
paragraphs.zh: 無論是2027年或2028年。

paragraphs.en: It was therefore investigating additional capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，該公司正在研究增加產能。

paragraphs.en: This indicates pressure on future equipment availability,
paragraphs.zh: 這顯示未來設備供應可能面臨壓力，

paragraphs.en: according to the company's own assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 這是根據該公司本身的評估。

paragraphs.en: It is not evidence that every proposed expansion
paragraphs.zh: 這並不代表每項提出的擴產計畫

paragraphs.en: has already been completed.
paragraphs.zh: 都已經完成。

paragraphs.en: TSMC's October 15 earnings call
paragraphs.zh: 台積電於10月15日舉行的法說會

paragraphs.en: adds a further view of computing demand.
paragraphs.zh: 進一步呈現了運算需求的面貌。

paragraphs.en: The company said high-performance computing
paragraphs.zh: 該公司表示，高效能運算

paragraphs.en: accounted for 68% of third-quarter revenue,
paragraphs.zh: 占第三季營收的68%，

paragraphs.en: while smartphones contributed 21%.
paragraphs.zh: 而智慧型手機貢獻21%。

paragraphs.en: Revenue from these platforms increased by 22%
paragraphs.zh: 這兩類平台的營收分別增加22%

paragraphs.en: and 10%, respectively, from the previous quarter.
paragraphs.zh: 及10%，比較基準為前一季。

paragraphs.en: Both grew, but at different speeds.
paragraphs.zh: 兩者都成長，但速度不同。

paragraphs.en: The figures describe platform categories;
paragraphs.zh: 這些數字描述的是平台分類；

paragraphs.en: they do not identify every individual customer's purchases.
paragraphs.zh: 並未揭露每位個別客戶的採購情況。

paragraphs.en: Careful comparisons require consistent reference points.
paragraphs.zh: 審慎的比較需要一致的參考基準。

paragraphs.en: Intel's growth figures above compare equivalent quarters
paragraphs.zh: 前述英特爾的成長數字比較的是相同季度，

paragraphs.en: in two different years.
paragraphs.zh: 但分屬不同年份。

paragraphs.en: The TSMC platform figures compare neighboring quarters.
paragraphs.zh: 台積電的平台數字則比較相鄰兩季。

paragraphs.en: Those percentages answer different questions.
paragraphs.zh: 這些百分比回答的是不同問題。

paragraphs.en: The reports also use different currencies
paragraphs.zh: 這些報告也使用不同幣別，

paragraphs.en: and describe different kinds of business.
paragraphs.zh: 並描述不同類型的業務。

paragraphs.en: Reading them together can reveal patterns,
paragraphs.zh: 把它們放在一起閱讀，有助於發現趨勢，

paragraphs.en: but simply ranking their headline numbers
paragraphs.zh: 但若只憑整體數字直接排名，

paragraphs.en: can hide the details that explain those patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 可能會掩蓋解釋這些趨勢的重要細節。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these October reports suggest
paragraphs.zh: 綜合來看，這些10月的報告顯示，

paragraphs.en: that computing demand is reshaping several businesses
paragraphs.zh: 運算需求正在改變多項業務，

paragraphs.en: without lifting every activity equally.
paragraphs.zh: 卻沒有讓每種業務都同樣受惠。

paragraphs.en: That is an interpretation of the reported figures,
paragraphs.zh: 這是對已公布數據的解讀，

paragraphs.en: not a prediction of future sales.
paragraphs.zh: 並非對未來銷售額的預測。

paragraphs.en: For people following technology news,
paragraphs.zh: 對關注科技新聞的人來說，

paragraphs.en: the useful question is which products, customers,
paragraphs.zh: 值得問的是：哪些產品、客戶，

paragraphs.en: or production stages are driving a change.
paragraphs.zh: 或生產階段正在推動變化。

paragraphs.en: A single growth number cannot tell the whole story.
paragraphs.zh: 單一成長數字無法說明完整情況。

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of the article?

choices.text: To rank three companies only by their total quarterly sales.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第6段提醒幣別、業務種類與比較基準不同，只按整體數字排名可能掩蓋細節。

choices.text: To show that every chip-related business is growing equally.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第1、2及5段提供不同業務的差異，第7段也明確指出並非所有業務都同樣受惠。

choices.text: To explain uneven business growth and the need for careful comparisons.
choices.explanation: 正確。文章以英特爾、艾司摩爾及台積電的10月報告說明業務成長速度不同，再解釋比較數據時應留意的基準。

choices.text: To predict which company will have the highest future sales.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第7段明確將全文定位為已公布數據的解讀，而非未來銷售預測，也未預測誰將排名第一。

quiz.explanation: 本題考主旨。第7段總結運算需求改變多項業務，但受惠程度不同；第6段補充不能忽略比較期間、幣別及業務類型。因此，全文重點是理解差異與審慎比較，而非公司排名或業績預測。

evidence.quote: Taken together, these October reports suggest that computing demand is reshaping several businesses without lifting every activity equally.
The reports also use different currencies and describe different kinds of business.

quiz.question: What can be inferred from Intel's two business groups?

choices.text: The faster-growing group can still have lower revenue.
choices.explanation: 正確。第2段中資料中心暨AI事業群成長78%、營收73億美元；另一事業群成長率為負5%、營收卻較高，達81億美元。成長較快不代表規模較大。

choices.text: The group with higher revenue must also grow faster.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第2段正好提供反例：營收較大的第二事業群，其成長率反而較低。

choices.text: Both groups had lower revenue than a year earlier.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。只有第二事業群年減5%，第一個事業群則年增78%，不能說兩者都下降。

choices.text: The data-center group's growth was measured against the previous quarter.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第2段寫的是與去年同季相比，第6段也再次說明英特爾數字採跨年度的相同季度比較。

quiz.explanation: 本題考合理推論。比較第2段的兩組數字可知，成長率是變化速度，營收是當期規模；成長率高的業務，其當期營收仍可能小於成長率低的業務。兩個指標必須分別判讀。

evidence.quote: Intel's Data Center and AI group recorded revenue of $7.3 billion, up 78% from the same quarter last year. Meanwhile, its Client Computing and Physical AI group reported $8.1 billion, down 5%. The second group remained larger by revenue, even though its growth rate was lower. This comparison shows why business size and speed of growth should be considered separately.

quiz.question: Which conclusion best summarizes the article for a reader comparing the reports?

choices.text: The largest percentage always identifies the largest business.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第2段顯示成長率較高的事業群，營收仍可較小，因此百分比大小不能直接代表業務規模。

choices.text: Growth figures should be read with their time periods and business categories.
choices.explanation: 正確。第6段指出英特爾採跨年度同季比較，台積電平台採相鄰兩季比較；幣別和業務類型也不同，必須連同背景閱讀。

choices.text: All the growth percentages use the same comparison period.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第6段明確對比兩種期間基準，並說明它們回答不同問題。

choices.text: The equipment sales figures count finished computer chips.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第3段直接區分設備銷售與製成晶片數量，兩者代表供應鏈中不同的事物。

quiz.explanation: 本題考整體總結。要理解這些報告，須先確認每個數字衡量什麼，以及它與哪段期間比較。文章以業務類別、供應鏈位置、幣別及比較期間提醒讀者，單一成長數字無法解釋完整情況。

evidence.quote: Intel's growth figures above compare equivalent quarters in two different years. The TSMC platform figures compare neighboring quarters. Those percentages answer different questions.
The second group remained larger by revenue, even though its growth rate was lower.
That is a measure of equipment sales, rather than the number of finished computer chips.
